prose.text: The gates below run in /implement P2 (on the merged, uncommitted tree) and in the wrap's light gate (on the committed merge). - **Merge witness and guards.** The first entry is the merge witness. It is green when upstream's pin is MERGE_HEAD (before the operator's commit) or an ancestor of HEAD (after it), and red on the untouched tree. The next eight probe the merged manifest, the lock, `.github/`, the package manifests and stand sources, and the upstream delta:   - Their git bases are the chunk start commit `ab936a9e` or the fixed upstream shas, so they survive the pre-CI commit.   - The additivity entry is report-only. It lists every code path whose content differs from the clean auto-merge, re-derived by `git merge-tree`, which is deterministic. Each listed path must be a recorded step-5 fix. - **Gate legs.** `fast` is the local pre-push gate, and its `target/ci-logs/test.log` feeds the count entry. Then `doc`, `audit` and `a11y`, then the agent-run proof. - **Windowed boot smoke.** It runs because blitz-paint `render.rs` and the Taffy and Parley pins change what `seven_guis_native` renders. It declares `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` and reads `not run — env unset` without one. It turns `timeout`'s 124 into exit 0 (verification-harness.md Session Additions, 2026-10-06), and its atom comes from test-plan.md's Stand log format reading, as in 2026-10-06-headless-stand's plan. - **Not listed locally.** The `msrv` leg (`cargo +1.91`) and the wasm leg run on CI only: this host has no 1.91 toolchain or wasm32 target (measured in 2026-10-06-telemetry-bootstrap's plan). P3 read every new dependency's rust-version as ≤ 1.91.0 (parley 1.88, vello 1.89, taffy 1.71). The operator entries push the merge and read the CI run that covers both legs. - **No live leg.** This chunk drives no external process. - **The pre-merge count has no listed producer, by construction.** `evidence/pre-merge-counts.txt` is read on `ab936a9e` before the merge. No gate can re-run it on the merged tree, so implementation step 1 produces it once, as a one-shot reading. The count entry and the report compare it against the post-merge reading.
